note: A priority encoder written with casez. CURRENTLY FAILS, DELIBERATELY, on hif-backend#84: hif2verilog regenerates it as a plain `case` with the `?` bits spelled `z`, so under exact matching every wildcard alternative is unreachable and five of eight rows fall through to the default. Behavioral because the output is valid Verilog that exits 0 and reparses cleanly - both keywords are legal around the same alternatives. Two rows need no wildcard and act as controls, so the failure reads as 'the wildcards are gone' rather than as a scrambled encoder.
